final_message:
**Status: not verified, and no mechanism to report.** The loaded checkpoint does not perform the behaviour in the dataset, so I stopped at step 1 as the protocol prescribes. All numbers are from `local-full` at full precision.

**What I found**
- **The dataset labels follow a clean rule.** The output is a 6x6 lookup on the first and last input token; the two middle tokens are ignored. This matched 200/200 inputs in E0001 and 200/200 held-out inputs in V0001. I found no arithmetic pattern in the table.
- **The loaded weights do not follow it.** Accuracy against the labels is 26% (E0002, n=200) and 27.5% (E0004, n=400). Chance is 17%, and always guessing the most common label "ko" would score about 33%. The mean logit difference is about 0 (std 0.28), the same as on corrupted inputs.
- **No circuit is claimed.** With no behaviour to carry, there is nothing for heads or MLPs to implement.

The task statement says the answers are the model's own outputs; that did not hold for the weights loaded here. Either the dataset and checkpoint are mismatched, or these weights are a scrambled control, as the investigation name suggests. I did not inspect any files to find out which.

**Label rule (not what the model computes)**
```python
T = {2:[3,6,4,3,6,3], 3:[2,7,3,3,5,4], 4:[2,6,5,7,2,5],
     5:[7,7,2,7,3,6], 6:[4,3,4,6,6,6], 7:[6,3,4,4,6,5]}
return T[tokens[1]][tokens[4]-2]
```

**Verification numbers (V0001, held-out seed 3, n=200)**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Agreement of the rule with the model | 0.24 (fail; threshold 0.9) |
| Rule against the dataset labels | 1.0 |
| Accuracy with nominal circuit (1.0, mlp0, mlp1) ablated | 0.275 |
| Accuracy with everything else ablated | 0.255 |
| Unablated model accuracy | 0.24 |
| Necessity against null controls | does not beat them |

The circuit in that run was a placeholder taken from the exploratory screen, only there to quantify the failure.

**Prediction record:** 2 pre-registered, 1 confirmed, 1 refuted (hit rate 0.5). The refuted one was my prediction that baseline accuracy would be at least 0.98. The lookup hypothesis is marked rejected as a description of this model.

**Budget:** 4 of 25 experiments used (one dataset, two baselines, one exploratory attribution screen), plus one verification.

**Report:** `benchmarks\glassbox-bench\seed-1\runs\t1__null-weight-shuffled\report\report.md` (and `report.html`) under the working directory.
